selection_metric: Mean of category Macro-F1 and gated fine-grained Macro-F1 across 3 training-policy folds
features: Word 1–2 grams plus char_wb 3–5 grams; each branch <=60000 features; min_df=2; sublinear TF; per-branch L2 normalization
class_weight: balanced within each binary training problem
attribute_training: Only gold-applicable training segments per attribute head; constant predictor if only one class
schema_scope: Fixed from outer training policies; TF-IDF vocabularies and IDF refit inside every CV fold
text_scope: Full segment text, no transformer token truncation

fine_grained.balanced_accuracy_definition: mean over fine-grained values of (sensitivity + specificity) / 2

independent_attribute_heads.balanced_accuracy_definition: mean over fine-grained values of (sensitivity + specificity) / 2
